svg.text: MTL amortised (condensed signature + one signed ladder) — measured per-message
No amortisation (full MTL signature on every message) — measured per-message
OLS fit of MTL-amortised batch total (extrapolated)
Points = measured per-message time; dashed line = OLS fit of the MTL-amortised batch total.
The fit (slope + intercept/N) extrapolates only along the measured MTL-amortised shape.
